questions.stem: What are the three mutually perpendicular lines in a three-dimensional coordinate system called?
questions.solution: The three mutually perpendicular lines in a three-dimensional coordinate system are called the x, y, and z axes. These axes are perpendicular to each other and intersect at a single point, forming the basis of the coordinate system. The other options do not represent the standard naming convention for these axes.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the three coordinate planes in three-dimensional geometry?
choices: To represent the position of a point in a plane
To determine the distance between two points in space
To locate the position of a point in three-dimensional space
To calculate the area of a shape in space
questions.solution: The three coordinate planes in three-dimensional geometry are used to determine the exact location of a point by measuring its perpendicular distances from each plane. This allows for a unique identification of the point's position in space. The other options are incorrect because they describe functions not directly tied to the role of coordinate planes, such as distance calculation or area measurement.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the correct way to represent the coordinates of a point in three-dimensional geometry?
questions.solution: In three-dimensional geometry, a point is represented by three coordinates, which are written in the form (x, y, z). This format accounts for the three axes: x, y, and z. The option (x, y) represents a point in two dimensions, (x) represents a single dimension, and (x, y, z, w) corresponds to four dimensions.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा त्रिविमीय ज्यामिति में एक बिंदु के निर्देशांक के प्रतिनिधित्व का सही तरीका है?
hi.solution: त्रिविमीय ज्यामिति में, एक बिंदु के तीन निर्देशांक होते हैं, जिन्हें (x, y, z) के रूप में लिखा जाता है। इस प्रारूप में तीन अक्षों: x, y, और z को शामिल किया गया है। विकल्प (x, y) द्विविमीय ज्यामिति के बिंदु का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, (x) एक विमा के बिंदु का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, और (x, y, z, w) चार विमाओं के संगत है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms as found in Hindi-medium textbooks.

questions.stem: If a point lies in the XY-plane, which of its coordinates will be zero?
questions.solution: A point in the XY-plane lies on the plane where the z-coordinate is constant and does not vary, so it must be zero. The x and y coordinates can be non-zero as they define the position within the plane. The other options are incorrect because the x and y coordinates are not necessarily zero in the XY-plane.

hi.stem: यदि कोई बिंदु XY-समतल में स्थित है, तो इसके कौन से निर्देशांक शून्य होंगे?
hi.solution: XY-समतल में स्थित कोई बिंदु वह समतल पर होता है जहां z-निर्देशांक नियत रहता है और बदलता नहीं है, इसलिए यह शून्य होना चाहिए। x और y निर्देशांक समतल में स्थिति को निर्धारित करते हैं, इसलिए ये शून्य नहीं हो सकते। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि XY-समतल में x और y निर्देशांक आवश्यक रूप से शून्य नहीं होते।

questions.stem: If a point is equidistant from (1, 2, 3) and (3, 2, –1), which of the following equations represents the set of such points?
questions.solution: The equation of the set of points equidistant from (1, 2, 3) and (3, 2, –1) is derived by setting the distances equal. Simplifying gives 2x + z = 0. The other options do not satisfy the condition of equidistance.

hi.solution: बिंदुओं के वह समुच्चय जो (1, 2, 3) और (3, 2, –1) से समान दूरी पर हैं, का समीकरण दूरियों को बराबर रखकर व्युत्पन्न किया जाता है। सरलीकरण करने पर 2x + z = 0 प्राप्त होता है। अन्य विकल्प बराबर दूरी की शर्त को संतुष्ट नहीं करते हैं।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology in Hindi.

mr.stem: जर एक बिंदू (1, 2, 3) आणि (3, 2, –1) पासून समान अंतरावर असेल, तर खालीलपैकी कोणते समीकरण अशा बिंदूंच्या संचाचे प्रतिनिधित्व करते?
mr.solution: (1, 2, 3) आणि (3, 2, –1) पासून अंतर समान असलेल्या बिंदूंचे समीकरण अंतर समान करून विकसित केले जाते. सोपे करून 2x + z = 0 मिळते. इतर विकल्प अंतर समानतेच्या अटीला अनुरूप नाहीत.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about the coordinates of a point on the x-axis?
choices: It is of the form (0, y, 0)
It is of the form (0, 0, z)

questions.stem: A point P has coordinates (4, −3, 7). Which of the following statements is correct?
choices: P lies in the first octant
P lies in the second octant
P lies in the fourth octant
P lies in the sixth octant
questions.solution: The signs of the coordinates determine the octant. In the sixth octant, the x-coordinate is positive, the y-coordinate is negative, and the z-coordinate is positive. The point (4, −3, 7) has these exact signs, so it lies in the sixth octant. The other options do not match the sign pattern of the coordinates.

questions.stem: What is the geometric meaning of the equation PA + PB = k in three-dimensional space?
questions.solution: In three-dimensional geometry, the set of points P such that the sum of the distances from P to two fixed points A and B is constant represents an ellipsoid. The other options describe different geometric shapes that do not fit the given equation.
